```{python}
#| label: fig-ground-isolation-ownership
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "A floating body labeled `VSS` couples capacitively to reference net `VSS`. Equal spelling does not make an electrical connection."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=13)
    elm.Line().at((-2,0)).to((2,0))
    elm.Dot().at((0,0))
    elm.Label().at((0,.6)).label('Floating body: VSS')
    elm.Label().at((3,0)).label('Independent potential', loc='right')
    elm.Capacitor().at((0,0)).down().length(3).label('C')
    elm.Dot().at((0,-3)).label('VSS', loc='right')
    elm.Ground().at((0,-3))
    elm.Label().at((3,-3)).label('Reference net', loc='right')
```
